newsitem.title: FINLAND: Viking sees 96/97 profit on par with 95/96.
newsitem.headline: Viking sees 96/97 profit on par with 95/96.

text.p: Finnish passenger ferry operator Viking Line AB said in a statement on Thursday it expected group earnings for the financial year to end-October 1997 to be about on par with its 1995/96 earnings.
"Earnings for the operating year 1996/97 are expected to be of about the same size as in the year gone by," Viking Line said referring to its 1995/96 earnings.

Viking Line said it did not expect any major changes in the operating environment in 1997. Thanks to its recent ferry purchase Viking said it would be "well equipped to compete successfully for passengers."
The company's pre-tax profit in the 12-month financial year to end-October 1996 rose 54 percent to 123.4 million markka. Net sales rose eight percent to 1.87 billion markka.
